description: Exact block-swapped bound symmetrization S_atom for ⁴He (task-1, #2103 follow-up). tr_atom_sym = ¼Σ_{σ∈S₂×S₂} tr_M(W_atom·β_σ) with β_σ the positive block-swap braid (NOT the orbit identity's relabeling — that is conjugation; the Young symmetrizer composes the braid). Sign-only (chi_q_via_gp). The binding signal of identical-nucleon exchange is the residual log(S_free/S_atom): if the bonds break block symmetry, S_atom ≠ S_free and the symmetrization does NOT cancel in the log-ratio binding.
